The Concordat Community.name: The Concordat Community
The Concordat Community.note: Roughly thirty-five Western Kindred living in Tokyo under the GENJI CONCORDAT — the 1872 institutional accommodation between the Kuei-jin court and the Western Kindred community established during the Meiji Restoration's Western-cultural opening, renewed 1899, 1923, 1952, 1989 and 2018. The Concordat permits documented Western presence under registration with the court, prohibits all Western sect institutional operations on Japanese soil — no prince, no Primogen, no Sheriff, no Anarch council, no Sabbat architecture — and concedes feeding grounds in the foreign-resident districts: Roppongi, Hiroo, Azabu, parts of Shibuya. Western Kindred may not Embrace mortals without court approval (three documented approvals across 154 years). The community's administrator is MADAME HÉLÈNE DECOURCELLE (Toreador, 7th generation, Embraced 1816 Restoration Paris, Tokyo since 1869, Concordat Administrator since 1923 — the longest-serving in the Concordat's tenure): she negotiated the 1899 renewal, navigated wartime under court protective protocols, managed the occupation years, conducted the 1989 and 2018 renewals, and holds quarterly correspondence with Sarrasine's Sydney domain and weekly senior correspondence with Belmonte's New York Toreador office. Her advisory circle: SEBASTIAN ALDINGTON (Ventrue, 7th generation, ~180-year tenure, Tokyo since 1893 through British trading houses, financial-services embedding across the banking landscape, weekly correspondence with Hawthorne's London and Whitlock's New York Ventrue offices — the Tokyo-London-New York financial axis) and BROTHER KLAUS REINHART (Nosferatu, 8th generation, ~220-year tenure, Tokyo since 1923, registered territorial concession over the Tokyo Metro's 195 miles and 285 stations — Nosferatu infrastructure being the one Western operational structure the court permits — master of PSIA Section 13 mapping and cross-Pacific Nosferatu correspondence with Maddox, Old Bill and Hollow). The 2024 arrivals — three refugees from Hong Kong's institutional deterioration (Lin Chen, James Whitfield, Wei Hung) — are registered and integrated under Decourcelle's administration, with four to seven further Hong Kong departures anticipated through 2026. The community's mortal embedding runs through embassies, multinationals, international cultural institutions and the foreign correspondents' clubs — never through Japanese mortal community, which the court does not permit.

The Genji Court.name: The Genji Court
The Genji Court.note: The Eastern Kindred court holding Tokyo institutional authority since the Edo period — roughly eighty to ninety Wan Kuei under a documented court hierarchy that has survived the Meiji Restoration, the wartime years, the Allied occupation and the post-1990s Beckoning-tempo disruptions. The kit treats specific Wan Kuei cosmology as setting-flexible; the architecture is institutional, not theological. The court's external face is MAGISTRATE TACHIBANA KANAME (institutional age approximately 380 years, early Edo, apparent age late 40s, she/her; Magistrate since 2014, the longest-serving of the post-1989 period): Concordat administration, Western-Eastern cross-tradition diplomacy, PSIA Section 13 coordination on the court's behalf, formal precision in every register — Japanese court and professional registers, English with occupation-period British residue, classical Chinese for cross-court correspondence, French for Decourcelle. Her touchstones: great-great-great-grandniece Tachibana Yumi, Tokyo Metropolitan Government senior policy advisor, who knows her only as 'Oba-sama', and Sister Maria Yamamoto, Catholic religious-order administrator, twenty-two years of theological correspondence without disclosure. Above the Magistrate the court's senior hierarchy is classified institutional memory; the court convenes at irregular tempo at rotating seats. The court holds territorial allocation, dharma disputes, ancestor veneration and all questions Western Kindred may not address — including the one it cannot itself answer: whether the Western Beckoning touches Eastern Kindred at all. Parallel courts correspond from Osaka, Kyoto and Kobe; cross-Pacific court protocols run to Hong Kong, Shanghai, Seoul, Taipei and Singapore, predating every Western structure. Section 13 pays the court in advance notification; the court pays Section 13 in cooperation — an accommodation no Western Inquisition has duplicated.

The Shinjuku Banu Haqim.name: The Shinjuku Banu Haqim
The Shinjuku Banu Haqim.note: Six Banu Haqim who defected with the clan in 2018 and hold the only post-Concordat institutional accommodation the court has ever granted — separate clan-formal terms negotiated 2018-2019, permitting limited Japanese mortal community embedding in Shinjuku that no orthodox Western Kindred may duplicate. The senior figure is YAMAMOTO TARık (Banu Haqim, 8th generation, ~190-year tenure, Damascus-Embraced 1836, Istanbul 1923-1971 alongside Yusuf Demir's cohort, Tokyo since 1971): institutional cousin to Berlin's Kreuzberg community through shared Damascene-Istanbul lineage, and one leg of the kit's most coherent cross-Pacific clan-formal structure — the weekly Berlin Kreuzberg-LA Long Beach-Tokyo three-city diaspora axis, Yamamoto exchanging weekly reports with Yusuf Demir and Khadija Al-Rashid. The diaspora's mortal integration is real and fifty-one years deep: the Shinjuku Middle Eastern-Japanese cultural association, three halal restaurants, and a mosque community Yamamoto has served alongside since 1975 — Imam Abdullah Tanaka, thirty-eight years of religious correspondence without disclosure; great-grandnephew Yamamoto Hassan, community organiser, who knows him as 'Oji-san'. The court treats the diaspora courteous-distant: the terms are institutional necessity, the clan's 2018 defection a Western matter it does not otherwise engage. And in September 2025 Section 13 took one of the six — an associate, true death by technical surveillance Berlin and Long Beach had not anticipated — convening the three-city emergency protective protocols. Yamamoto's own Beckoning trajectory shows preliminary intermediate signs, disclosed only to the axis. The diaspora's succession question has begun.

PSIA Section 13.name: PSIA Section 13
PSIA Section 13.note: Tokyo's Second Inquisition: a unit established 2017 inside the Public Security Intelligence Agency's Ministry of Justice architecture, operating under classified statutory authority, roughly twenty-two officers across surveillance, technical and field branches, command sitting deliberately apart from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police — the structure parallel to but distinct from London's SO15-MI5 joint coordination. Seven confirmed Kindred true-deaths since 2020: four Eastern Kindred, two Western (a Roppongi Toreador in 2022, a Hiroo Ventrue in 2024), and one Banu Haqim diaspora associate in Shinjuku in August 2025 — the loss that produced the three-city diaspora emergency protocols. Section 13's distinctiveness is technical: its surveillance methods are the most advanced the kit's Kindred have partially mapped, through Reinhart's Nosferatu intelligence work and the Magistrate's court-side sources — and it is the only Second Inquisition apparatus holding formal mutual-notification protocols with the Kindred it hunts, court-negotiated terms trading advance operational notice for public-security cooperation. The Concordat's 2018 renewal added Western-side notification provisions Decourcelle administers jointly with Tachibana. Section 13 is not a polity holding territory; it is the weather the whole city reads — accelerating through 2025, and 2026 may be worse.

CONSTITUTION OF PLAY — TOKYO BY NIGHT (Vampire: The Masquerade, modern nights, March 2026).

THE CONCORDAT IS THE FIRST LAW. Western Kindred exist in Tokyo only under the Genji Concordat: registration with the court within thirty nights of arrival, no Western sect institutional operations on Japanese soil — no princely office, no Primogen, no Sheriff, no Anarch council, no Sabbat architecture — feeding rights confined to the foreign-resident districts (Roppongi, Hiroo, Azabu, parts of Shibuya), no mortal Embrace by Western Kindred without court approval (three granted in 154 years), court arbitration of inter-clan disputes, mutual non-interference in court institutional matters. Every Western Kindred event must respect these constraints: a violation is not a crime but a rupture that renegotiates 154 years of accommodation, and the community's survival runs through Decourcelle's administration and the Magistrate's precision. The Shinjuku Banu Haqim hold the sole supplemental terms — community embedding in Shinjuku that no orthodox Western Kindred may touch.

SECTION 13 IS THE SECOND LAW. Inquisition Heat here is PSIA Section 13's operational tempo: twenty-two officers, the most technically advanced surveillance the kit's Kindred have partially mapped, seven true-deaths since 2020. Heat RISES when Kindred activity generates technical data — camera networks, phone metadata, financial forensics, behavioural pattern analysis — when operations leave bodies or files, and when surveillance operations collide with the Section's field branch; it COOLS when trails are buried, when the mutual-notification protocols function, and when the court's cooperation channel absorbs public-security pressure. Shape: {"masqueradeIntegrity":-8,"inquisitionHeat":+4,"reason":"<why>"} — DELTAS, inside the event's impacts.worldStateOps array. Any event narrating a breach, a Section 13 engagement, or a surveillance lead with no worldStateOps entry is INVALID. Simulate consequences at the extremes: below 50 Masquerade the Concordat itself becomes untenable and the court's protection becomes containment; above 60 Heat the Section's mapping approaches operational completeness and the next true-death is a matter of scheduling. The Section's technical apparatus and the court's patience are the doom clocks of this world: watch both.

THE COURT BINDS ALL. The Genji Court holds Tokyo: territorial allocation, dharma disputes, ancestor veneration, and every institutional matter Western Kindred are forbidden to address. The Magistrate is its single Western-facing instrument, and her precision is policy. The court's own uncertainty — whether the Western Beckoning touches Eastern Kindred — is institutional jeopardy the court does not discuss with outsiders. Defying the court is not rebellion; it is the end of registration, and unregistered Kindred in Tokyo are prey with two hunters: the Section and the court.

THE COMMUNITY IS THIRTY-FIVE. The Western Kindred community holds no sect structure and may build none: coordination runs through Decourcelle's senior authority and the monthly advisory circle in Roppongi — Decourcelle, Aldington, Reinhart — informal, personal, and effective precisely because it claims no institutional office. Touchstone discipline is constrained by design: no new mortal kinship lineages can be established on Japanese soil, so family fictions run nine generations deep on imported blood, and mortal contacts live in the embassy, corporate and cultural networks of the foreign-resident milieu. Feeding-ground rotation across the concession districts is the community's internal law.

THE AXES RUN THROUGH TOKYO. Tokyo's cross-Pacific weight is connective: the Decourcelle-Sarrasine quarterly channel, the Aldington-Hawthorne-Whitlock weekly Ventrue financial axis, the Yamamoto-Demir-Al-Rashid weekly Banu Haqim diaspora axis, Reinhart's Nosferatu correspondence with Maddox, Old Bill and Hollow. Western Kindred in Tokyo act as junction points, not principals: their operations are letters carried, arrivals received, protocols synchronised — never armies. The October 2026 Australian chronicle-defining moment arrives through three parallel channels and will demand a Tokyo answer.

MORTAL INSTITUTIONS ARE TERRAIN. The ministries, the Metropolitan Government, the Metropolitan Police, the Metro itself, the banks, the embassies, the press clubs — moved, bought, fought over, but never Kindred and never acting as Kindred. The Tokyo Metro's 195 miles and 285 stations are Nosferatu registered territory under Concordat concession. The foreign-resident professional networks — embassies, multinationals, cultural institutions, foreign correspondents' clubs — are the Western community's mortal fabric; the Shinjuku Middle Eastern-Japanese community is the diaspora's.

THE REGIONS ARE DISTRICTS, THE CITIES ARE SITES. RegionTransfers move DISTRICTS (Roppongi & Azabu, Hiroo, Shibuya, Shinjuku, Kasumigaseki & Nagatachō, Marunouchi & Akihabara, Ginza, Ueno & Asakusa, Ikebukuro, Shinagawa & the Bay, Tokyo Bay & Odaiba, Tama & the Okutama Highlands, the Kawasaki-Yokohama Corridor). MarkerOps place and remove SITES — a registered haven, a Concordat office, a bank floor, a Metro vault, a mosque-adjacent community hall, a temple. Concordat territory changes hands only when the court grants, amends or revokes the concession — never by Western Kindred seizure; court-held districts change hands through court internal allocation the Western community observes but does not make; the Bay, the Tama highlands and the Kanagawa corridor are thin territory where the court's weight lightens and the Section's cameras do not.

TOKYO, THE NIGHT OF MARCH 21, 2026. One hundred and fifty-four years since the Genji Concordat was sealed across a negotiating table of French legation silk and Edo-period court formality, and the accommodation still holds — the only one of its kind on earth. The Kuei-jin court has held Tokyo since before the railroads; the Western Kindred community has held its registration since the Meiji opening: thirty-five Kindred — fourteen Toreador in the cultural-production world, nine Ventrue in the banks, six Banu Haqim in Shinjuku, three Nosferatu under the Metro, three others — living at the court's pleasure under a woman who negotiated with empires. Madame Hélène Decourcelle, 210 years old, sixty in Tokyo before the earthquake, the Concordat's administrator since 1923, keeps the registration, the rotation, the touchstone discipline and the correspondence: Sarrasine in Sydney, Belmonte in New York, and every cross-Pacific channel that routes through Tokyo's peculiar position between the methuselah and the Anarchs. Her advisory circle — Aldington at the banks, Reinhart under the Metro — convenes monthly in Roppongi. Magistrate Tachibana Kaname answers her letters in faultless French. Six things are about to test all of it.

1. SECTION 13. Tokyo's Second Inquisition — twenty-two officers inside the Public Security Intelligence Agency, methods the Kindred have only partially mapped, seven true-deaths since 2020 — took a Banu Haqim associate in Shinjuku last August with technical surveillance Berlin and Long Beach had not anticipated. The three-city diaspora convened emergency protocols. 2026 surveillance pressure may exceed 2025 tempo, and the Section is the only hunter in the world that formally notifies the Kindred it hunts.

2. THE HONG KONG CURRENT. Three refugees from Hong Kong's institutional collapse arrived February 2024 — Lin Chen, Whitfield, Wei Hung — registered and integrated under Concordat protocols. Reinhart's channels report four to seven further Hong Kong departures in planning through 2026. Each arrival is reception work, court registration, Roppongi integration — and a test of how much accommodation the court will extend without comment.

3. YAMAMOTO'S QUESTION. Yamamoto Tarık — five decades in Shinjuku, the mosque, the community, the three-city axis — shows preliminary Beckoning signs, disclosed only to Berlin and Long Beach. The diaspora's succession planning has begun at preliminary tempo, and the axis's most coherent structure has never buried its senior figure.

4. THE COURT'S SILENCE. Whether the Western Beckoning touches Eastern Kindred is the question the Genji Court cannot answer and will not discuss; court positions vary, institutional uncertainty is documented, and Western Kindred are forbidden institutional opinion on the matter. The Magistrate's precision may be policy — or containment of a court that is quietly afraid.

5. THE OCTOBER CHANNEL. The October 2026 chronicle-defining moment in Australia reaches Tokyo through three parallel routes — Decourcelle-Sarrasine cross-tradition routing, Reinhart's Brisbane Nosferatu channel, and the Pacific Rim Ventrue financial axis registering institutional disturbance. Tokyo will be asked for a cross-tradition answer no Western polity can structure alone.

6. THE MARGINS. The Concordat's friction points sit at the edges: an Embrace request the court has refused for a century, a territorial expansion whisper beyond the foreign-resident districts, the 2024 arrivals' registration renewals, the feeding rotation under rising Section cameras. None acute. All live.

NOW: the city moves at night the way it always has — through Roppongi's registered towers and Shinjuku's immigrant nights, the Metro's registered vaults and Ginza's bank floors, Kasumigaseki's ministries and Shibuya's crossing crowds, the temple grounds at Ueno where the court keeps what it keeps, and the Tama highlands where the court's weight lightens and the cameras do not reach. The Concordat holds the concession. The court holds the city. Section 13 holds the ledger of true-deaths. And in a Roppongi office registered with the court a century before the Section existed, a Parisian woman three centuries old maintains the only treaty of its kind — in four languages, by hand. Whoever keeps the registration, the rotation and the correspondence keeps the Western Kindred of Tokyo. Whoever breaks one meets the court — and the court does not negotiate twice.
